Keep all visible text exactly as shown.
Maintain the bright celebratory sale mood and the clean white-to-pink retail backdrop.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square smartphone sale poster with a white-to-pink glowing city background and a red geometric portal behind the products. Place the red cellphoneS logo at the top center, a red date pill '6 - 12.7', and the headline 'Tuần Lễ Poco' in red with handwritten-style 'Tuần Lễ'. Add a coral-red split pricing banner reading 'Giá từ 7.99 Triệu' and 'S-Teacher & S-Student Giảm đến 300K'. In the center show four POCO phone renders: one front-facing black-screen hero and three angled rear-view phones in black, yellow, and blue. Add floating red balloons around the scene, a bottom line 'TRẢ GÓP 0% | Trả trước 0đ | Phụ phí 0đ', and a rounded white CTA button 'MUA NGAY'. Technical style: commercial smartphone promotion poster, bright retail campaign lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
